**Evaluating marker clusters**

I’m analyzing a grid background with 9s and 0s, focusing on a marker at the center. I want to identify if the cluster of markers forms a connected component with specific coordinates. After checking, it seems all the positions are connected, even diagonally in some cases. The marker may form a pattern that uses coordinates within a defined bounding box. I need to recolor certain cells in the grid from 0 to 5. It’s time to compute and present the output!

grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in rows_txt.splitlines()]
pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==5]
print(pts)
# normalized from bounding box
rmin=min(r for r,c in pts); cmin=min(c for r,c in pts)
mask={(r-rmin,c-cmin) for r,c in pts}; print(mask, max(r for r,c in mask),max(c for r,c in mask))
out=[row[:] for row in grid]
hits=[]
for dr in range(len(grid)-(max(r for r,c in mask)+1)+1):
 for dc in range(len(grid[0])-(max(c for r,c in mask)+1)+1):
  if all(grid[dr+r][dc+c]==0 for r,c in mask):
   hits.append((dr,dc))
   for r,c in mask: out[dr+r][dc+c]=5
print('hits',len(hits),hits)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
